verdict.rationale: Pricing is a fair axis for a hosted search product. Orama's pricing page only says the open-source library is free and describes an enterprise-style assessment engagement. It publishes no per-search, per-record, or per-node rates for Orama Cloud that a founder could use to forecast cost.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing (searches, records, or nodes) lets me predict what search will cost before committing
